## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` passes (if UI, IPC, recording or export changed)
- [ ] New or changed behavior has tests
- [ ] No new network access, telemetry or unvalidated IPC; no renderer-supplied file paths
- [ ] Docs and CHANGELOG updated; new dependencies added to THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md
- [ ] No secrets, certificates, personal data or real-desktop screenshots committed
- [ ] I am contributing this under GPL-3.0-only (optional: commits signed off with `git commit -s`)
